content.title: Parade Information | Syracuse St. Patrick's Parade
content.text: Connacht Division (1) – arrive at 11:15 a.m. – line up on South Salina Street at the corner of East Water Street (NOT Erie Boulevard; Marshals will be there to assist you – please line up in accordance with the Marshals’ instructions.) Grand Marshal Division (2) – arrive at 11:30 a.m. – line up on Erie Boulevard West at Clinton (Marshals will be there to assist you – please line up in accordance with the Marshals’ instructions). It is best to enter the route at the intersection of S Geddes St and Erie Blvd W (near Arby’s), heading east on Erie, until you reach your position on the Parade route. Marshals will be available along the way to direct you. *DO NOT STAGE ON W. GENESEE ST. BETWEEN SALINA & CLINTON* Project Children Division (3) – arrive at 11:45 a.m. – line up near National Grid on Erie Boulevard West (Marshals will be there to assist you – please line up in accordance with the Marshals’ instructions). It is best to enter the route at the intersection of S Geddes St and Erie Blvd W (near Arby’s), heading east on Erie, until you reach your position on the Parade route. Marshals will be available along the way to direct you. Leinster Division (4) – arrive at 12:00 p.m. – line up on Erie Boulevard West – west of National Grid (Marshals will be there to assist you – please line up in accordance with the Marshals’ instructions). It is best to enter the route at the intersection of S Geddes St and Erie Blvd W (near Arby’s), heading east on Erie, until you reach your position on the Parade route. Marshals will be available along the way to direct you. Munster Division (5) – arrive at 12:30 p.m. – line up west of the 690 Bridge (Marshals will be there to assist you – please line up in accordance with the Marshals’ instructions). It is best to enter the route at the intersection of S Geddes St and Erie Blvd W (near Arby’s), heading east on Erie, until you reach your position on the Parade route. Marshals will be available along the way to direct you. Ulster Division (6) – arrive at 1:00 p.m. – line up near Plum Street west of the 690 Bridge (Marshals will be there to assist you – please line up in accordance with the Marshals’ instructions). It is best to enter the route at the intersection of S Geddes St and Erie Blvd W (near Arby’s), heading east on Erie, until you reach your position on the Parade route. Marshals will be available along the way to direct you.
